data.name: My Universe
data.detailed_description:
You play as a single cell that, after a series of scientific experiments, develops unique and extraordinary abilities. In this game, you can create powerful synergies by combining different skills, slow down time, unleash flames, and freely shoot, burn, poison, or electrocute enemies as you explore an entirely new world.

Your goal is to defeat every opponent you encounter, progressing through multiple zones and facing a variety of bosses, each more distinct and challenging than the last.

The game features mechanics that allow you to craft your own unique ability combinations, further enhanced by passive upgrades that you can earn whenever you die or after conquering a zone. These upgrades offer meaningful choices: you can enhance your character in exchange for something of equal value. Alternatively, if you choose not to take these upgrades, you can continue without any penalties.

Each player chooses their own playstyle, creating unique builds and strategies.
